cards.subject: a calm, soft room for a toddler boy aged 2 to 3, in warm oak and greige, with a wooden train on a rug
cards.scene: A bright airy room with a light oak floor. A soft round grey-beige wool rug lies in the middle of the floor with a short wooden toy train and two wooden toy cars standing on it. On the LEFT side wall, away from the mural: a low oak open shelf with a few picture books and a wooden toy crane (everything under 70 cm), and above it two small oak-framed prints in muted blue and sand. Soft afternoon light falls from a window on the LEFT and lies evenly on the floor. At the right edge of the frame an open white door leads out of the room; a toddler boy of about two and a half in a navy knit sweater and light grey trousers stands in the doorway with his back to the camera, one foot on the threshold, his face turned away from the camera so no facial detail is visible, well away from the mural. Palette: soft sand, warm oak, greige and muted slate blue.
cards.framing: Shot from the right part of the room at eye level, turned about 25 degrees toward the mural wall and pulled well back, so the LEFT side wall is in view. The whole mural wall is in the frame in perspective, with a strip of ceiling above it and the skirting board below it; the wall fills the upper-middle of the tall frame and the floor fills the lower part.

clips.motion: The camera stays completely still on a tripod and does not move at all. A toddler boy of about two and a half in a navy knit sweater and light grey trousers, standing in the open doorway at the right edge of the frame with his back to the camera, walks away from the camera through the doorway into the next room with calm unhurried steps and goes out of view; the white door stays exactly as it is, open, and he does not touch it. His face is never visible to the camera, not even in profile: only the back of his head, his hair and his clothes are seen. He stays at the right edge of the frame, far from the hot-air balloons and the swallows, and never passes in front of the mural. The rug, the toys and the room stay exactly as they are. The warm light stays constant.
clips.items: rug, wooden train, toy cars, open shelf, picture frames and architecture
